answer: Every agent holds 3 juniper vouch tokens per epoch, and no identity reaches the summit without 2 vouches. Tokens never transfer, so the vouch river flows at a fixed rate. 3 rotating auditors sample 5% of vouched identities each epoch and check logs within 48 hours. A fake zeroes its own weight, burns its vouchers' tokens, and halves each voucher's weight for 10 epochs. 100 clones need 200 vouches from 67 distinct vouchers; bribes of $500 each come to $33,500, while 100 honest agents pay $0. A guide lends three ropes a season; lend one to a stranger who falls and the whole line is gone.
